_README: The release notes the app shows after a Sparkle update installs.
This file IS the published manifest — it is uploaded verbatim to
https://dl.corkkam.com/whats-new.json. Edit it here, in a PR, like code.
TO ADD A RELEASE:
1. Add an entry to `releases` below. `version` must match the
CFBundleShortVersionString in Resources/Info.plist for that release.
2. Record a demo video, then upload it out of band:
bash Scripts/upload-whats-new-media.sh 1.1.0 demo.mp4 poster.jpg
That prints the two URLs — paste them into videoURL / posterURL.
3. Validate before pushing:  bash Scripts/publish-whats-new.sh --check
RULES THE VALIDATOR ENFORCES (see Scripts/whats-new-validate.py):
- `version` and `headline` are required on every release.
- versions are well-formed semver and unique.
- `releases` is sorted NEWEST FIRST.
- videoURL / posterURL must be https (the app rejects anything else).
NOTES:
- videoURL, posterURL and highlights are all optional. A release with no
video is a perfectly good note — the highlights carry it.
- The video is STREAMED, never bundled in the app, so you can publish or
replace one without cutting a release.
- One manifest serves all three channels (stable / beta / dev).
- `systemImage` is any SF Symbol name.
- A first install never sees this — only a genuine upgrade does.
- Keys the app doesn't know (like this one) are ignored, by design.

highlights.title: Dictate anywhere
highlights.body: Hold the Globe key and talk. Your words land in whatever app you're in — all transcribed on-device.

highlights.title: Ask your assistant
highlights.body: Hold fn + control to file a note, set a reminder, or ask what's on your calendar.

highlights.title: Nothing leaves your Mac
highlights.body: Transcription runs entirely on-device. No audio is ever uploaded.
